name: Stephen
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament

points: The saying pleased the multitude, and they chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Ghost, with Philip and the others, and set them before the apostles, who prayed and laid hands on them. Men are not picked because they ask to be officers or captains; they must fit the criteria and have served for a time, with a pattern of good works, full of the Holy Ghost and full of wisdom.

note.label: Acts 6: The Grecians Were Greek-Speaking Israelites

points: Stephen, full of faith and power, did great wonders and miracles among the people. He was doing the same work being done today, reasoning out of the scriptures with the Israelites scattered through the diaspora.

note.label: Acts 6: The Grecians Were Greek-Speaking Israelites

points: The synagogue of the Libertines, along with the Cyrenians, Alexandrians, and those of Cilicia and of Asia, rose up disputing with Stephen. The Libertines were Jews and proselytes who had been Roman slaves and obtained their freedom, or were their descendants; Pompey enslaved Jews who kept the sabbath and the kosher law so strictly they were useless as slaves, so he released them.

note.label: Acts 6: The Grecians Were Greek-Speaking Israelites

points: Devout men carried Stephen to his burial and made great lamentation over him. A devout man is a man according to the laws of the Most High who has a good report.

note.label: Acts 8: The Word Scattered Abroad, and the Baptism unto the Conscience

points: Verse 19 shows that those scattered abroad upon the persecution that arose about Stephen traveled as far as Phenice, Cyprus, and Antioch, preaching the word. Some people would not accept this and persecuted the believers, and the people scattered further out and took this gospel with them.

note.label: Acts 10 Reloaded: Call No Man Common

points: Those scattered by the persecution over Stephen traveled as far as Phenice, Cyprus, and Antioch, preaching the word to none but the Jews only, going where the Israelites were scattered. Phenice was the coastal region north of Israel, modern Lebanon; Cyprus is an island in the eastern Mediterranean; and Antioch was a major Roman city in ancient Syria, now Antakya, Turkey.

cases.name: The false witnesses against Stephen
cases.charge: Suborning witnesses and stirring up the council against a man they could not answer
cases.preview: Men of the synagogues of the Libertines, Cyrenians, Alexandrians, Cilicia and Asia disputed with Stephen and could not resist the wisdom and the spirit by which he spoke (Acts 6:9-10).
